description: Search the article archive by keyword (headline, summary, key facts, entities, tickers). Use get_latest instead for the newest articles without a query; open a hit's full text with get_article (the slug comes from the search results). Matching is a case-insensitive substring match of the whole query against each article's headline, summary, key facts, entities, and tickers — not a semantic search; headline matches rank first, then newest first. An empty query returns an error. count is the number of articles returned. Returns {query, count, articles} with the same brief shape as get_latest. Behaviour: read-only and public — no authentication or API key; served from the site's published article files, and every call is logged in aggregate (tool name, query, result count, coarse client class; no IP addresses).
name: search_articles
title: Search Articles
